method_note: Top model-conviction plays (odds-independent). TWO real-outcome guards from the settled ledger: (1) CURATION -- market families proven to lose money are hard-excluded (ROI, not hit rate); (2) EMPIRICAL CALIBRATION -- each probability is blended toward its family's realized hit rate, so the number shown is honest. Heavy game-line favorites (fair <= -150) and trivially-juicy prop lays (fair <= -350) excluded. Tier by calibrated probability: ELITE >=72%, STRONG >=66%, SOLID >=60%.
